title: Training-Free Dynamic Upcycling of Expert Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2603.29765v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable performance on a wide range of specialized tasks, exhibiting strong problem-solving capabilities. However, training these models is prohibitively expensive, and they often lack domain-specific expertise because they rely on general knowledge datasets. Expertise finetuning can address this issue; however, it often leads to overspecialization, and developing a single multi-domain expert remains difficult due to diverging objectives. Furthermore, multitask training is challenging due to interference and catastrophic forgetting. Existing work proposes combining the expertise of dense models within a Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture, although this approach still requires multitask finetuning. To address these issues, we introduce Dynamic Upcycling MoE (DUME), a novel approach that reuses dense experts trained on different domains to construct a unified MoE model. Our method

translated_title: 免训练的专家语言模型动态升级
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在广泛的专业任务上取得了卓越的性能，展现出强大的问题解决能力。然而，训练这些模型的成本极其高昂，且由于依赖通用知识数据集，这些模型往往缺乏特定领域的专业知识。专业知识微调可以解决这一问题；然而，这通常会导致过度专业化，且由于各领域目标存在分歧，构建单一的多领域专家模型仍然十分困难。此外，由于任务间的干扰和灾难性遗忘问题，多任务训练也面临巨大挑战。现有工作提出在专家混合架构中组合稠密模型的专业知识，但这种方法仍然需要进行多任务微调。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了动态升级专家混合模型，这是一种新颖的方法，能够复用在不同领域上训练的稠密专家模型，从而构建一个统一的 MoE 模型。
tldr: 本文提出 DUME，一种免训练的新方法，通过复用不同领域训练好的稠密专家模型来动态构建统一的 MoE 模型，从而避免多任务微调带来的过度专业化和灾难性遗忘问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DUME, a training-free approach that dynamically constructs a unified Mixture-of-Experts model by reusing dense experts trained on different domains, avoiding overspecialization and catastrophic forgetting associated with multitask finetuning.
